profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV and registered with CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish site presents a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and the company says it has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The models described on the site are the G6, G9 and P7+. The company says these combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the 800-volt SEPA 2.0 electric platform, which it says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km.

The Spanish site handles enquiries through CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as data controller, and financing is offered by Open Bank, S.A. Example pricing given is 43.010,31€ cash or 39.410,31€ financed for the XPENG G6 RWD Standard Range 185kW, and 59.010,30€ cash for the XPENG G9 RWD Standard Range. No lawsuits involving the company are recorded.
